scope: Fixed L=16 A1 production q^-4 Gaussian, three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, positive production Q_II, eta_shell=0, and any one fixed A7 common real-even scalar regulator family with finite multiplier bound M_R. The coefficient field Z and derivative carrier Y are independent Gaussian copies. Exact/dealiased products and each regulator's exact derivative covariance are used. Executable numeric constants instantiate the contractive M_R=1 subfamily; the analytic theorem retains the explicit M_R^4 factor.

regulator_class.description: One fixed family of common real-even scalar Fourier multipliers on all six real components, converging pointwise to one, with compact support or a uniform Schwartz tail.
regulator_class.bound_semantics: The executable constants certify the contractive subfamily |r_Lambda(k)|<=1. For a general admitted family with M_R=sup_(Lambda,k)|r_Lambda(k)|<infinity, replace C_A and K_B by M_R^4 times the displayed contractive constants.

model.coefficient: B(Z)=sum_A [a p_A p_A^T+b(p_A v_A^T+v_A p_A^T)+c v_A v_A^T]
model.quadratic_composite: With G_Lambda=D R_Lambda C^(1/2) and T_Lambda,b=G_Lambda^* M_b G_Lambda on the common white-noise space, Q_Lambda(Z,Y)=1/2(<xi_Y,T_Lambda,B(Z_Lambda) xi_Y>-Tr T_Lambda,B(Z_Lambda)).

theorem.deterministic_background: For every deterministic measurable PSD b in L2(T^3;R^(6x6)) and every p>0, E exp[-p Q_Lambda,b(Y)]=det_2(I+p T_Lambda,b)^(-1/2), where T_Lambda,b=(D R_Lambda C^(1/2))^* M_b(D R_Lambda C^(1/2))>=0 on the common white-noise space.
theorem.trace_ideal: For a fixed regulator family with M_R=sup_(Lambda,k)|r_Lambda(k)|, sup_Lambda ||T_Lambda,b||_S2^2 <= C_A(M_R)||b||_L2^2, from the q^-4 symbol and sup_q sum_k <k>^-2<k-q>^-2<infinity.
theorem.nelson_bound: For every fixed p>0, sup_Lambda E_(Z,Y) exp{-p[U_Lambda(Z)+Q_Lambda(Z,Y)]}<infinity.
theorem.full_sequence: The decoupled actions converge in probability on the common product Gaussian space; the p>1 estimate gives L1 convergence of weights, partition convergence, total-variation convergence of lifted product-space densities, and weak convergence of the projected full-sequence laws.
theorem.finite_gaussian_divergence_identity: For the original self-coupled finite cutoff, 2 V_Lambda^ren=delta_gamma b_Lambda with b_Lambda(xi)=C_Lambda^(1/2)D^*[B(X_Lambda)D X_Lambda]; the DB trace vanishes only because D_x C_Lambda(x,y)|_(y=x)=0 in the common-even class.

analytic_constants.symbol_coercivity: c_symbol=inf_(x>=0)(Y x^2+Z x+r)/(1+x)^2>0; the nonnegative internal mass is discarded for the lower bound.
analytic_constants.trace_ideal_constant: C_A(M_R)=M_R^4 S_L/(|T_L^3| c_symbol^2); the executable enclosure uses the contractive subfamily M_R=1.
analytic_constants.sextic_absorption: With A_p=p^2 K_B+p max(-lambda,0)/4 and b_p=p gamma/6, sup_(rho>=0)(A_p rho^2-b_p rho^3)=4A_p^3/(27b_p^2).

self_coupling_residual.adapted_drift_form: A sufficient load-bearing estimate is: for every epsilon>0, uniformly in Lambda and all progressive u, E V_Lambda^ren(X_Lambda+h_Lambda(u)) >= -epsilon E[int||u_t||_2^2 dt+||h_Lambda(u)||_6^6]-C_epsilon.
self_coupling_residual.smart_path_form: As an alternative sufficient route, for independent X,Y and Z_r=rX+sqrt(1-r^2)Y, bound uniformly the positive variation of Phi_Lambda(r)=log E exp{-p[U_Lambda(X)+Q_Lambda,B(X)(Z_r)]} from r=0 to r=1.
self_coupling_residual.recommended_route: Dyadic scale freezing plus a uniform commutator estimate for B(X_<=j)-B(X_<j-2) under every adapted Cameron-Martin drift.
self_coupling_residual.boundary: A7's L2 composite convergence controls only the unshifted action, and the present det_2 theorem controls only an independent derivative carrier. Neither implies the adapted-drift estimate.
